question: Mekapati Vikram Reddy, who became Member of Legislative Assembly from Atmakur constituency in Andhra Pradesh, in June 2022, belongs to ______ political party.
solution:
The correct answer is __**YSR Congress Party.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct political party that **Mekapati Vikram Reddy **belongs to is** YSR Congress Party.**
 
• YSR Congress Party is a regional political party in **Andhra Pradesh**, India, founded by **Y. S. Jaganmohan Reddy** in **2011.**
 
• Mekapati Vikram Reddy is an Indian politician who represents the **Atmakur Assembly constituency **in the **15th **Andhra Pradesh Assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP) is a national political party in India, currently in **power at the federal level**.

 
 
• It is known for its **right-wing ideology** and **Hindutva politics.**
 
 
 
• **Communist Party of India **(CPI) is a left-wing political party in India, founded in **1925**.
 
 
• It advocates **socialism and secularism.**
 
 
 
• **Indian National Congress **(INC) is one of the oldest political parties in India, founded in **1885**.
 
 
• It is a **centre-left party** and has been in power at the **federal level** for several terms.
